description: BGP session state for every peer this switch is configured with, one row per peer. The SENSE:{{sense}} legend tells whether the session is part of the SENSE fabric (true = a SENSE-managed BGP session, false = an external/DOMESTIC peer). Established is green, OpenSent/OpenConfirm yellow, Connect/Active orange and Idle red. Peers the FE reports as unknown are not shown.

targets.expr:
(sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="established"}) > 0) * 6
or (sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="openconfirm"}) > 0) * 5
or (sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="opensent"}) > 0) * 4
or (sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="active"}) > 0) * 3
or (sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="connect"}) > 0) * 2
or (sum by (hostname, peer, iptype, sense) (bgp_session_state{hostname="REPLACEME_HOSTNAME", sitename="REPLACEME_SITENAME", bgp_session_state="idle"}) > 0) * 1

title: BGP Peer Status
